FaqData.question: How do I create account on the job board?
FaqData.answer: Use the search bar on the homepage to enter keywords related to your skills, job title, or preferred location. You can also use the advanced search filters to narrow down results by industry, job type (full-time, part-time, freelance), and experience level.
